destinations.name: Andaman Islands
destinations.overview: Far out in the Bay of Bengal, the Andaman Islands are India's tropical edge: powder-white beaches, glass-clear water and some of the healthiest coral reefs in the country, all reached by a short flight to Port Blair, now officially Sri Vijaya Puram. The town holds the islands' history in the Cellular Jail, the 'Kala Pani' prison of the freedom struggle, and across the harbour the banyan-wrapped ruins of Ross Island, now Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep. Fast catamarans hop to Swaraj Dweep (Havelock), home to Radhanagar beach and the country's best-known scuba sites, and to tiny, slow-paced Shaheed Dweep (Neil) with its natural rock arch. Further north, the road through the Jarawa reserve leads to Baratang's mangrove creeks and limestone caves. November to April is the best time to visit, with calm seas and clear water from January to April; the south-west monsoon (roughly late May to September) brings rough seas, heavy rain and frequent ferry cancellations.

trips.name: Andaman Express: Port Blair & Havelock
trips.overview: The Andamans in four days, at a backpacker's price. Join a fixed-date group of up to 18 in Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram) and start with the island's history: the Cellular Jail, where India's freedom fighters were exiled to 'Kala Pani', and its evening light and sound show. Next morning a private catamaran carries you to Swaraj Dweep (Havelock) for two nights in a simple cottage resort near Govind Nagar beach. Swim at Kalapathar's turquoise cove, watch the sun set over Radhanagar, and spend a free day snorkelling at Elephant Beach or trying your first scuba dive. Ferries, port fees, transfers, entry tickets and breakfasts are covered; lunches, dinners and water sports are yours to choose. A Ghumbo coordinator handles the tickets, ferry timings and early starts.

trips.name: Andaman Island Hopper: Havelock & Neil
trips.overview: Three islands in five days on a budget, with the ferries sorted. Meet the group in Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram) for the Cellular Jail, Corbyn's Cove and the evening light and sound show. A private catamaran then takes you to Swaraj Dweep (Havelock) for two nights: Kalapathar's turquoise water, sunset on Radhanagar beach and a free day for Elephant Beach snorkelling, a first scuba dive or bioluminescent kayaking. Next, hop to sleepy Shaheed Dweep (Neil) to walk out to the Natural Bridge at low tide, swim at Bharatpur and watch the sun go down at Laxmanpur, before a Sitapur sunrise and the ferry back. Stays are simple twin-share hotels and cottages with breakfast; all three ferries, port fees, transfers and entry tickets are included, and a Ghumbo coordinator travels with the group.

trips.name: Andaman Grand Circuit: Baratang, Ross, Havelock & Neil
trips.overview: The full Andaman loop in a week, at a budget price. Begin in Port Blair (Sri Vijaya Puram) at the Cellular Jail and its light and sound show. Next day, convoy north through the Jarawa Tribal Reserve to Baratang, where a speedboat slips through a mangrove tunnel to ancient limestone caves and a bubbling mud volcano. Then cross the harbour to the coral shallows and lighthouse of North Bay and the banyan-wrapped colonial ruins of Ross Island, now Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep. The second half is pure beach: two nights on Swaraj Dweep (Havelock) for Kalapathar, a Radhanagar sunset and a free day for Elephant Beach or a first scuba dive, then a night on quiet Shaheed Dweep (Neil) for the Natural Bridge, Laxmanpur sunset and Sitapur sunrise. Simple twin-share stays with breakfast, every ferry and boat, permits, entry fees and transfers are covered, with a Ghumbo coordinator throughout.

days.title: Baratang: mangrove creeks and limestone caves
days.overview: A long, rewarding day trip north along the Andaman Trunk Road. The road runs through the Jarawa Tribal Reserve in escorted convoys, so we leave before dawn. At Baratang a speedboat threads a tunnel of mangroves to the limestone caves, and we stop at the mud volcano before the return convoy.

activities.title: Pre-dawn departure from Port Blair
activities.description: Leave the hotel at 03:30 in the group AC Tempo Traveller with a packed breakfast, for the 50 km drive to the Jirkatang check post. Carry original government photo ID (Aadhaar, passport or driving licence).

activities.title: Convoy through the Jarawa Tribal Reserve
activities.description: Join the first escorted convoy (around 06:00) along the Andaman Trunk Road to Middle Strait, about 2 hours. Stopping, photography and any contact with the Jarawa are strictly prohibited by law. Convoy times are set by the administration and can change.

activities.title: Vehicle ferry to Baratang
activities.description: A short government vehicle ferry across the strait from Middle Strait to Nilambur jetty on Baratang Island.

activities.title: Speedboat through the mangrove creek
activities.description: A shared forest-department speedboat runs through a narrow creek walled by tall mangroves (about 25 minutes each way). Boat and forest permit included.
activities.location: Nilambur jetty to Limestone Caves jetty

activities.title: Limestone Caves
activities.description: Walk about 1–1.5 km along a jungle and village path to the caves, then explore stalactites and stalagmites shaped over millions of years. Bring a torch and shoes with grip.

activities.title: Mud volcano
activities.description: A short drive to one of the few mud volcanoes in India, where cool grey mud bubbles up from below.

activities.title: Lunch
activities.description: Simple fish or veg thali at a Baratang jetty eatery - pay direct, approx ₹200–300.

activities.title: Return convoy to Port Blair
activities.description: Vehicle ferry back to Middle Strait and the afternoon convoy through the reserve to Jirkatang, then on to Port Blair.

activities.title: Dinner
activities.description: Dinner on your own near the hotel - approx ₹300–500.

days.accommodation: Budget hotel near Aberdeen Bazaar, Port Blair (AC twin room, attached bath)

days.title: North Bay and Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep (Ross Island)
days.overview: A harbour-hopping day from Port Blair: the coral shallows and lighthouse of North Bay (the view on the old ₹20 note), then the ruined British headquarters of Ross Island, now Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep, overrun by banyan roots and wandering deer.

activities.title: Breakfast
activities.description: Breakfast at the hotel.

activities.title: Boat to North Bay Island
activities.description: From the Rajiv Gandhi Water Sports Complex (Aberdeen jetty), a shared tourist boat across the harbour to North Bay. Combined North Bay and Ross boat ticket included.

activities.title: North Bay beach and lighthouse
activities.description: Time on the small beach and coral shallows below the red-and-white lighthouse.

activities.title: Sea walk, snorkelling or semi-submarine
activities.description: Optional, paid at North Bay: sea walk approx ₹3,000–3,500, snorkelling approx ₹1,000–3,000, glass-bottom boat or semi-submarine (coral safari) approx ₹1,000–3,500. Water sports stop in rough seas.

activities.title: Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep (Ross Island)
activities.description: Walk among the roofless church, bakery, Chief Commissioner's house and officers' club of the old British penal settlement, swallowed by peepal and banyan roots, with spotted deer and peacocks for company. Entry included.

activities.title: Lunch
activities.description: Late lunch back in town - pay direct, approx ₹250–400.

activities.title: Free evening on the Marina
activities.description: Rest, or stroll along Marina Park and the Rajiv Gandhi Water Sports Complex waterfront at sunset.

activities.title: Dinner
activities.description: Dinner on your own; your coordinator briefs the group on the morning ferry. Approx ₹300–500.

days.accommodation: Budget hotel near Aberdeen Bazaar, Port Blair (AC twin room, attached bath)

days.title: Ferry to Swaraj Dweep (Havelock): Kalapathar and a Radhanagar sunset
days.overview: An early catamaran across Ritchie's Archipelago to Swaraj Dweep (about 1.5–2 hours). Spend the late morning on the rocky, turquoise shore of Kalapathar, then head to Radhanagar, often ranked among Asia's best beaches, for a swim and the sunset.

activities.title: Breakfast and check-out
activities.description: Early breakfast at the hotel (packed if the ferry is very early).

activities.title: Private ferry to Swaraj Dweep
activities.description: Transfer to the jetty and board a private catamaran (Makruzz, Nautika or Green Ocean, base class; operator depends on availability) for the 1.5–2 hour crossing. Tickets and port fees included. Keep motion-sickness tablets handy.
activities.location: Port Blair jetty to Havelock jetty

activities.title: Check in at Havelock
activities.description: Check in to a simple cottage resort near Govind Nagar beach (Beach No. 3), a few minutes from the jetty and the main market.

activities.title: Kalapathar beach
activities.description: A narrow strip of white sand and clear turquoise water edged by black rocks and tall forest, on the island's quiet east coast.

activities.title: Lunch
activities.description: Lunch at a beach shack or market café - pay direct, approx ₹300–450.

activities.title: Rest at the resort
activities.description: Time to rest through the hottest part of the day.

activities.title: Radhanagar beach (Beach No. 7) and sunset
activities.description: By group vehicle to the island's west coast: a long arc of powder-white sand backed by mahua forest. Swim only between the lifeguard flags, then watch the sun drop into the sea (sunset is around 17:00–17:30 in winter).

activities.title: Dinner
activities.description: Dinner on your own at a Havelock market restaurant; your coordinator can suggest seafood and wood-fired pizza spots. Approx ₹400–600.

days.accommodation: Budget beach-side cottage resort near Govind Nagar (Beach No. 3), Swaraj Dweep (twin room, attached bath)

days.title: Elephant Beach, reefs and a lazy Havelock day
days.overview: A flexible day on Swaraj Dweep. Most of the group takes the shared speedboat to Elephant Beach for snorkelling and water sports, and the afternoon is free for a first scuba dive, a kayak or simply the beach.

activities.title: Breakfast
activities.description: Breakfast at the resort.

activities.title: Elephant Beach by speedboat
activities.description: Optional, approx ₹1,000 return per person: a 20-minute shared speedboat ride from Havelock jetty to Elephant Beach, with shallow reefs for snorkelling; a basic snorkel is usually included. Sea walk (approx ₹3,500) and glass-bottom boat rides (approx ₹1,000–1,500) are paid on the spot. Boats run only when the forest and port authorities allow. Those not going can walk to Govind Nagar or Vijay Nagar beach instead.

activities.title: Lunch
activities.description: Lunch on your own - pay direct, approx ₹300–450.

activities.title: Try scuba dive
activities.description: Optional, approx ₹5,500–6,500: a beginner's boat dive with a PADI/SSI centre (no swimming needed, about 2–3 hours including briefing; 30–40 minutes underwater). Book through your coordinator a day ahead. Do not fly within 18–24 hours of diving.

activities.title: Free afternoon on the beach
activities.description: Laze at Govind Nagar or Vijay Nagar beach, rent a scooter (approx ₹600–700 a day) or browse the market.

activities.title: Sunset or bioluminescence kayaking
activities.description: Optional, approx ₹3,500: a guided kayak through the mangroves at sunset, or after dark on moonless nights to see the plankton glow.

activities.title: Dinner
activities.description: Dinner on your own - approx ₹400–600.

days.accommodation: Budget beach-side cottage resort near Govind Nagar (Beach No. 3), Swaraj Dweep (twin room, attached bath)

days.title: Shaheed Dweep (Neil): the Natural Bridge and a Laxmanpur sunset
days.overview: A short hop to tiny, laid-back Shaheed Dweep (about 1 hour). Walk out to the Natural Bridge rock arch at low tide, swim in the calm shallows of Bharatpur, then end the day at Laxmanpur Beach No. 1 for the sunset.

activities.title: Breakfast and check-out
activities.description: Breakfast at the resort.

activities.title: Private ferry to Shaheed Dweep
activities.description: Morning catamaran from Havelock to Neil (about 45–60 minutes; operator and exact time depend on the season's schedule). Tickets and port fees included.

activities.title: Check in at Neil
activities.description: Check in to a simple cottage near the Neil Kendra market and Bharatpur beach.

activities.title: Bharatpur beach
activities.description: Calm, shallow water a short walk from the jetty, with a fringing reef just offshore. Glass-bottom boat rides are available here (optional, approx ₹1,000–1,500).

activities.title: Lunch
activities.description: Lunch at a Neil Kendra eatery - pay direct, approx ₹300–400.

activities.title: Natural Bridge (Laxmanpur Beach No. 2)
activities.description: Walk over the coral rocks at low tide to the island's famous natural rock arch, peering into tide pools for sea cucumbers, starfish and small fish. Timing is set by the tide; wear sturdy sandals and do not touch living coral.

activities.title: Sunset at Laxmanpur Beach No. 1
activities.description: A wide sweep of white sand facing west, the best sunset spot on the island.

activities.title: Dinner
activities.description: Dinner on your own at a Neil Kendra restaurant - approx ₹350–500.

days.accommodation: Budget cottage near Neil Kendra / Bharatpur Beach, Shaheed Dweep (twin room, attached bath)

days.title: Sitapur sunrise and back to Port Blair
days.overview: Catch sunrise at Sitapur on Neil's eastern tip, then a late-morning catamaran back to Port Blair (about 1.25–1.5 hours) and a drop at the airport for afternoon flights.

activities.title: Sunrise at Sitapur beach
activities.description: A short drive to Sitapur (Beach No. 5) for sunrise over the open sea and the limestone cliffs at low tide (sunrise is about 05:45–06:15 in winter).

activities.title: Breakfast and check-out
activities.description: Breakfast at the cottage and check-out.

activities.title: Private ferry to Port Blair
activities.description: The first private catamaran from Neil to Port Blair (usually around 10:00–11:00; about 1.25–1.5 hours). Tickets and port fees included.
activities.location: Neil jetty to Port Blair jetty

activities.title: Drop at Port Blair airport
activities.description: Group transfer from the jetty to Veer Savarkar International Airport (about 15 minutes); tour ends. Please book flights departing after 14:30.
activities.location: Veer Savarkar International Airport, Port Blair

inclusions.title: 6 nights' budget stays
inclusions.description: 3 nights in an AC budget hotel near Aberdeen Bazaar, Port Blair, 2 nights in a cottage resort near Govind Nagar beach, Havelock, and 1 night in a cottage near Neil Kendra; twin sharing, attached bath.

inclusions.title: Daily breakfast
inclusions.description: 6 breakfasts (Day 2 to Day 7), packed on the Baratang day (CP plan).

inclusions.title: Private catamaran ferries
inclusions.description: Port Blair–Havelock, Havelock–Neil and Neil–Port Blair on Makruzz, Nautika, Green Ocean or ITT Majestic (base class), with port and jetty fees.

inclusions.title: Baratang day trip
inclusions.description: AC Tempo Traveller via the Andaman Trunk Road convoy, vehicle ferry, shared speedboat to the Limestone Caves, forest permit and mud volcano.

inclusions.title: North Bay and Ross Island boats
inclusions.description: Shared tourist boat from Aberdeen jetty to North Bay and Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose Dweep, with Ross Island entry.

inclusions.title: Airport, jetty and sightseeing transfers
inclusions.description: Shared AC Tempo Traveller in Port Blair; shared AC vehicles on Havelock and Neil for every sight on the itinerary.

inclusions.title: Entry fees on the itinerary
inclusions.description: Cellular Jail entry and light and sound show, Ross Island entry and Baratang forest permit.

inclusions.title: Ghumbo group coordinator and 5% GST
inclusions.description: One coordinator with the group for all seven days (Hindi/English/Bengali); GST included.

exclusions.title: Flights to and from Port Blair
exclusions.description: Air fare to Veer Savarkar International Airport (IXZ) and back.

exclusions.title: Lunches and dinners
exclusions.description: All lunches and dinners at local eateries (budget approx ₹700–1,000 a day).

exclusions.title: Water sports at North Bay and Havelock
exclusions.description: Elephant Beach speedboat approx ₹1,000; sea walk approx ₹3,000–3,500; snorkelling, glass-bottom boat and kayaking paid locally.

exclusions.title: Scuba diving
exclusions.description: Optional try-dive approx ₹5,500–6,500 at Havelock, Neil or North Bay.

exclusions.title: Camera fees and ferry upgrades
exclusions.description: Camera fees at the Cellular Jail and Ross Island; upgrades to premium/royal ferry classes.

exclusions.title: Weather delays and ferry cancellations
exclusions.description: Extra nights, meals or rebooked flights if ferries are cancelled by the port authorities for bad weather; we rebook the group's ferries at no charge.

exclusions.title: Tips, insurance and personal expenses
exclusions.description: Gratuities, travel insurance, scooter hire, laundry, drinks and shopping.
